description: Use this when the user wants to hire a trade mark representative in Europe. It matches up to three firms with published IPRATE ratings per jurisdiction and returns a link where the user adds contact details and sends the request. Free for the user. Put no personal data in the description.

description.description: The matter in a few sentences. Leave out names, emails and phone numbers.

jurisdictions.description: EUIPO, BX (Benelux) or two-letter country codes.
